---
title: "Current implementation and first use"
---

Self-hosted document/reference library with implemented Phase 1/2 API, CLI, web client, imports and ingestion review. Later evidence-verification, bibliometric and systematic-review features remain roadmap work. Source checkout only; no published image or binary is claimed.

This page describes the source revision through the November 2026 audit. These source changes are not part of older development release downloads. Local checks are distinct from device, live-service and store acceptance.

## Build from a clean checkout

Node 22.23.4 and pnpm 9.15.4. Open http://127.0.0.1:5173; keep the API on localhost until authentication and deployment are configured.

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm build
node apps/cli/dist/index.js serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3000 --database ./local-library.sqlite --storage ./local-storage
# In another terminal:
pnpm --filter @recueil/web dev --host 127.0.0.1
```

These commands build and run the local service from this source tree. For the locally checked Linux ARM64 CLI/API container, follow the [deployment guide](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-recueil/blob/main/deploy/README.md). The November 2 synthetic container check passed startup, token enforcement, persistence, backup/restore and actual Compose host-loopback health; published images, public deployment and representative real-library acceptance remain separate gates.

## November Apple and credential audit

The [Apple audit](apple-audit-2026-11-08.md) records the locally built arm64 DMG, 14 Rust tests, credential isolation/deletion fixes, keyboard-undo correction and CLI process-cleanup checks. It distinguishes clean checks, resource-related timeout repeats, unresolved development-tool advisories and remaining signing/live-library acceptance. The [baseline desktop workflow](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-recueil/actions/runs/42527324842) passed Linux, Windows and macOS packaging before these refinements; the new source requires its own CI result.

## Use and verification

The [GitHub Actions run for source commit c4023d7](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-recueil/actions/runs/41200169067) passed on 2026-10-31: 2,496 tests on each of Node 22 and Node 24, 15 browser journeys, frozen installation, build, typing, lint, specification checks and production dependency audits. The audits reported no known vulnerabilities at that time. These source and CI results do not establish deployed operation or real-library acceptance.

Read the [repository README](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-recueil/blob/main/README.md) for the exact application workflow, privacy/storage behavior and platform differences. The [October refinement record](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-recueil/blob/main/spec/refinement-2026-10.md) records findings, changes, observed checks, deferred work and the next release action. See the workflow runs for the exact source commit; local verification does not establish a remote CI result.
